nate: quick post-mortem from the noon perf sweep: host-side parse/tokenization rising on edge with coalescer enabled, p95 up ~11%.
yara: stack sample?
nate: top: http1_frame_parse -> chunk_reassemble -> tokenize_stream -> utf8_normalize. grpc paths not as bad.
mika: traffic mix? http1 vs grpc?
nate: ~65% grpc, 35% http1. during window http1 p95 host parse ~2.7ms, grpc ~1.6ms.
yara: sounds like header/chunk reassembly + tokenize reallocs. any slab/pool numbers?
nate: pool hitrate decreased slightly; we saw extra mallocs when coalescer merged mismatched request sizes.
mika: kernel selection angle? mixed-length micro-batches could push selector to conservative kernels.
nate: yes logs show many batches with seq-stddev > 3.5, selector chosen fallback-kernel more often.
yara: quick mitigations: 1) pre-reserve token buffer to avoid realloc on small increments, 2) ascii fast-path to skip utf8_normalize for common payloads, 3) make coalescer respect seq-length buckets to avoid mixing tiny+long requests.
mika: also add clamp to variance calculation in kernel selector (clip to 95th pct for decision). cheap and low-risk.
perf-bot: ticket PERF-8008 created: "edge coalescer + host parse tail" assigned to nate,yara,mika.
nate: microbench results: pre-reserve reduced tokenize median 0.4ms -> 0.12ms; p95 improved ~28% in harness. ascii path saves ~0.15ms on ascii-heavy inputs.
yara: memory note: pre-reserve increases per-worker RSS; suggest pooled slab with per-worker cap and a recycle window. add cap metric.
mika: for http1, short-term: enable header-frag coalescing at ingress to combine small header writes before parse. long-term: push more internal routes to http2.
yara: runbook: land pre-reserve + ascii path behind flag (yara), implement coalescer buckets (nate), add selector-clamp flag (mika). canary at 5% then 25%.
nate: will add kvcache per-batch lookup meters; if cross-shard lookups spike we toggle affinity.
mika: agreed. aim to drop host_parse_p95 under 1.2ms for small requests.
yara: thanks team, open PRs with microbench artifacts please.
perf-bot: reminder: include flame traces in PR.
nate: will attach traces and bench logs by EOD.
